content.text: Let me add an exception safety net to the driver and re-verify:

arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
s = open('main.py').read()
old = """    try:
        parts = parse_request(req)
    except SchemaErr:
        emit({'error': 'E_SCHEMA'})
        return
    emit(compute(*parts))"""
new = """    try:
        parts = parse_request(req)
    except SchemaErr:
        emit({'error': 'E_SCHEMA'})
        return
    try:
        resp = compute(*parts)
    except SchemaErr:
        emit({'error': 'E_SCHEMA'})
        return

        sys.stderr.write('internal error: %r\\n' % (exc,))
        emit({'error': 'E_SCHEMA'})
        return
    emit(resp)"""
assert old in s
open('main.py','w').write(s.replace(old, new))
